picked.title: Counter-arm liveness check
picked.quote: For each frozen counter, list its arms and require one committed input per arm that moves that arm's tally away from zero. A passing control set did not reveal that round 53's re-key arm could never fire.
why_unimplemented: no tool or criterion enumerates a counter's arms and requires a committed input per arm; searched: filenames *arm* under tools/ .ufo/evidence corpus (only unrelated mutation-matrix and round-17 trace files), and the phrases 'per-arm', 'each arm', 'arm census', 'arm inventory' across md/py/sh/json

QUALITY 105 (corpus/QUALITY.md:1584-1586) proves one arm per round on a positive control at 'a tree where the round's work is present', which a zero-is-good guard arm cannot satisfy; its falsifier (:1590) is the rekey arm only
neither round-54 nor round-55 control script contains an input that moves tmp_mkdirs: grep -c tmp_mkdirs prints 0 for both

landing_drafted.text: An arm of a frozen counter has a committed input that moves it, not only a control that passes: for each arm the lane commits a receipt where the arm's value differs from its passing value; for a guard arm whose passing value is zero that input is a mutant reintroducing the defect the arm guards.
landing_drafted.falsifier: arm-census.py --lane LANE --rev 631cd64 prints the C2_R55 tmp_mkdirs row with nonzero=0 at the freeze commit; the same command over a tree that commits the mutant control prints nonzero>=1
landing_drafted.lesson_row: round-55 ## Mistakes row: class 'an arm with no committed input that moves it (a zero-is-good guard arm)', evidence C2_R54/C2_R55 tmp_mkdirs, captured-by none, fix criterion 106 + committed mutant control
landing_drafted.sources_row: NOT OWED — the claim is internal to the lane (its own counters and receipts); a SOURCES row would need an external carrier with a located quote in the census-validated register. Upstream operator input dated 2026-10-28 is cited by path.

arm_census.method: reads committed blobs (git show REV:path); every C[12]_R\d+ verdict line, bare or control-prefixed; tallies each key=value arm
arm_census.not_a_defect_by_itself: many zero-observed arms are 0/N base tallies moved by a later committed receipt (e.g. C1_R30 equiv_pass reads 0/4, 2/4, 4/4) or refusal counters (C1_R47 unobservable=0); the criterion requires existence of some committed moving input, not a design judgement

demonstration.fixture: git clone --shared of the lane at base, detached 0a2010ac; toplevel asserted before commit
demonstration.mutant: tools/env-diff.py strict_scratch_root(): 'return t' -> 'return "/tmp"' (one line, fixture clone only)
demonstration.command: env TMPDIR=<fresh usable dir> strace -f -e trace=mkdir,mkdirat -o LOG python3 tools/env-diff.py --selftest; count lines with 'mkdir' and '"/tmp'
demonstration.conclusion: the arm is live and discriminates purely on the /tmp prefix; the lane has never committed an input that moves it, and the tool's own fixture stays green

limits: the census is textual: arms printed under another key, counters without key=value summaries, and non-numeric values are invisible or unjudged
nonzero=0 is not by itself a defect; an author may declare an intentionally unreachable arm
no arm design was judged; only whether a committed input moves it
C1_R55 classes_corrected is listed at the freeze commit because round-55 deciding receipts do not exist yet (.ufo/evidence/round-55/after/ absent at the time of this seat)
